illustration_style: premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink editorial illustration
paper_rule: neutral white/off-white only; no yellow, mustard, sepia, parchment, beige/tan dominance, coffee-stained, or heavy cream cast
line_quality: fine ink and pencil linework with natural variation
background_style: soft cafe/friends environment fading into paper; background figures stay secondary and anonymous
texture: visible paper grain, transparent watercolor blooms, soft faded edges
text_style: readable hand-drawn charcoal typography baked into the image
negative_style_rules: no anime, cartoon, doll/model face, flat vector, or photorealism
no extra words, random letters, captions, speech bubbles, UI, or labels
do not copy tan/brown dominance, boxed brandmark, or bottom-right brandmark placement from style references
